serving.notes: config.json max_position_embeddings and tokenizer model_max_length are 40960. generation_config.json also sets max_length 40960. No repetition_penalty or max_new_tokens. The chat template accepts a system message but does not set one. The pad token is <|vision_pad|>; the architecture is Qwen3ForCausalLM with no vision tower. No adapter_config.json, notebook, or training script is in the repo. The base was loaded in bf16, not 4-bit.
